children: The benchmark indices closed higher amid consolidation on November 26, with the Nifty 50 rising 0.25 percent. Market breadth was positive on the NSE, with 1,825 stocks advancing compared with 1,471 declining stocks. Despite the possibility of further consolidation in the coming sessions, the broader market structure remains positive. Here are some short-term trading ideas to watch:
Jay Purohit, Vice President – Research at Spark Capital PWM

M&M continues to benefit from strong positive momentum across the auto sector, with the broader sectoral outlook remaining constructive. The stock has recently delivered a decisive trendline breakout on the weekly chart and is sustaining comfortably above its key moving averages on both daily and weekly timeframes, indicating a strengthening bullish trend.

Additionally, the RSI oscillator on both timeframes reflects sustained positive momentum, reinforcing the overall bullish technical setup. Going forward, the stock is well-positioned to extend its upward momentum towards the Rs 4,000 level over the coming months. Hence, positional traders can consider initiating fresh long positions at current levels and on dips, with a stop-loss at Rs 3,200.

Sportking India continues to trade in a strong uptrend and is hovering near its all-time high. The stock has recently broken out of a Bullish Flag pattern on the weekly chart, supported by noticeable volumes. The RSI oscillator and key moving averages are also positively aligned on the weekly timeframe, indicating sustained bullish momentum.

Going forward, the stock is likely to extend its ongoing uptrend towards the Rs 270 level over the coming weeks. Hence, traders can consider initiating fresh long positions with a stop-loss at Rs 215.

Poonawalla Fincorp has witnessed strong buying interest in recent sessions and recently registered a fresh 52-week high. The stock has delivered a decisive breakout above its year-long horizontal resistance zone, indicating a potential shift towards a sustained bullish trend.

It is also trading comfortably above its 50-day and 200-day EMAs on the daily chart, reinforcing the positive technical setup. Going forward, the stock is likely to extend its upward momentum towards the Rs 580 level. Hence, traders can consider initiating fresh long positions with a stop-loss at Rs 480.
Hitesh Tailor, Technical Research Analyst at Choice Broking

Lodha Developers has demonstrated good strength on the daily chart after breaking above its falling trendline. Following the initial breakout, the stock consolidated within a range and has now moved above that range with strong volumes, indicating fresh buying interest and the possibility of a continuation of its upward move.

The RSI is currently at 67.30, reflecting strong positive momentum. The recent range breakout, supported by rising volumes and a firm RSI, reinforces the bullish outlook. If the stock sustains above the breakout zone, it could move towards Rs 1,400. The stop-loss is placed at Rs 1,195.

TCS has registered a bullish breakout from an Inverted Head and Shoulders pattern on the daily chart, supported by rising volumes. The stock has also moved above the upper Bollinger Band following a period of contraction, indicating expanding volatility and improving momentum.

The RSI has recovered strongly from 41.02 to 70.90, reflecting improving buying momentum. The combination of the chart pattern breakout, volume support and strengthening momentum points towards a bullish technical setup. If the stock sustains its strength, it could move towards Rs 2,900. The stop-loss is placed at Rs 2,500.

Torrent Pharmaceuticals has broken out of its recent trading range on the daily chart, backed by strong volumes. The moving averages are also showing positive signals, with the 20-day EMA crossing above the 100-day EMA, indicating a potential shift towards a stronger uptrend.

The MACD has further reinforced the bullish setup with a positive crossover, accompanied by an expansion in the green histogram bars. This suggests improving buying momentum. With the stock breaking out of its range and key technical indicators turning positive, it could extend its upward move towards Rs 5,500. The stop-loss is placed at Rs 4,770.
Om Mehra, Technical Research Analyst at Samco Securities
SBI Life Insurance Company | CMP: Rs 1,842.3

SBI Life Insurance has been forming a consistent sequence of higher highs on the daily chart following a strong recovery from its recent low. The stock has also witnessed a positive moving average crossover, with the shorter-term average moving above the longer-term average, further strengthening the improving trend.
It is trading comfortably above the Supertrend indicator, which continues to act as a strong support. The Rs 1,850 zone remains the immediate resistance to watch for a decisive breakout.

The RSI is firmly placed near 64, indicating healthy momentum. The weekly chart also maintains a bullish structure, lending further strength to the overall technical setup. Hence, traders can consider initiating long positions at the current market price (CMP) of Rs 1,842.3, with an upside target of Rs 1,920 and a stop-loss at Rs 1,780.

Swiggy has witnessed a prolonged correction from its peak levels and is now showing signs of stabilisation around the Rs 175–177 zone. The stock has been consolidating near this support area over the past few sessions, indicating a possible pause in the prevailing downtrend.

The lower Bollinger Band, placed near Rs 172.70, is providing near-term support, while the middle band at Rs 184.11 remains an important resistance level. A sustained move above this level could strengthen the recovery and pave the way for an upside towards Rs 195–198. Volumes are marginally above the recent average, lending support to the latest uptick.
Hence, traders can consider initiating long positions at the CMP of Rs 182.93, with an upside target of Rs 198 and a stop-loss at Rs 173.

Aegis Logistics has witnessed a sharp correction and is now attempting to build a strong base near its recent lows. The stock has started recovering following an upward breakout from its descending trendline, opening up the possibility of further gains.

It is trading above the VWAP of Rs 1,198, indicating improving intraday strength. The RSI has recovered from the oversold zone and is currently placed near 48, suggesting a gradual improvement in momentum.
Hence, traders can consider initiating long positions at the CMP of Rs 1,211.2, with an upside target of Rs 1,310 and a stop-loss at Rs 1,160.

title: Trade Spotlight: How should you trade TCS, Sportking India, Lodha Developers, Torrent Pharma, SBI Life Insurance, and others on November 27?
